_comment: The brain. Claude reads/writes this every class. 'bucket': new|learning|review|mastered. 'due' is the next date to test (YYYY-MM-DD). Intervals grow with 'streak': 0->+1d, 1->+3d, 2->+7d, 3->+16d, 4->+35d, then mastered.

learner.name: Гріша
learner.context: Team Lead at Accenture (EMEA collections); 5 years in Ireland
learner.profile: Conversationally fluent from immersion; formal grammar knowledge limited; vocabulary precision and spelling under normal typing pull the picture down. Wants a foundational rebuild from parts of speech up, not just error-patching.

level.note: Structure trends B2/C1 when slowed down; spelling + vocab precision at typing speed pull it down. Learner thinks the placement may be generous. Re-assess every ~10 classes.

rule:parts-of-speech.note: Lesson 1, in progress. Only loose familiarity with the 8 categories.

rule:comma-splice.note: His single most frequent punctuation error, casual and work writing.

pattern:tense-shift.note: Tense switches mid-sentence under typing speed.

word:to-too.note: Persists even under focused testing — not just a speed issue.

word:son-sun.note: Surfaced in a real work message to his manager. Real vocab gap, not a typo.

word:knew-new.note: Wrote 'new' for the past tense of 'know'.

pattern:spelling-precision.note: Cluster of high-frequency misspellings at typing speed (see words.md typo list).
